JUDGMENT

1. By this common judgment, I shall dispose of the petition filed by petitioner under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.

FACTS

2. Petitioner invited tenders on 26.09.2007 for supply, erection and commissioning of 220 KV Sub-Station at Gurugram. Respondent submitted bid and was awarded contract vide LOI dated 29.07.2008.

3. The Arbitral Award has been challenged by the petitioner interalia on following grounds:
(A) The learned Arbitrator failed to appreciate that the delay was attributable solely to the contractor.
(B) The claim for price variation was barred by limitation under the contract terms.
(C) Liquidated damages were rightly levied in terms of Clause 14.

AFFIDAVIT

I, Sandeep Kumar, Executive Engineer, HVPNL, Panchkula do hereby solemnly affirm and declare as under:

1. That I am the authorized representative of the appellant in the above titled appeal and am fully conversant with the facts of the case.

2. That the accompanying appeal under Section 37 of the Arbitration Act has been drafted under my instructions and the contents thereof are true and correct.

SECTION-III: TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

1.0 GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS

1.1 The equipment supplied shall comply with the latest edition of IEC standards.
1.2 The bidder must furnish certified type test reports conducted within the last 5 years from an accredited laboratory.

2.0 INSPECTION AND TESTING

2.1 Notice for inspection shall be given at least 15 days in advance.
2.2 Dispatch clearance will be issued only upon successful testing.

ANNEXURE-C: TENDER SUBMISSION CHECKLIST

* Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of INR 500,000/- enclosed in Envelope A.
* Technical Bid containing unpriced schedule in Envelope B.
* Price Bid in prescribed format in Envelope C.
* Valid GST registration certificate and PAN copy attached.
* Power of Attorney in favor of authorized signatory.

CONCLUSION

18. In view of the discussion above, the petitioner has failed to establish any patent illegality or violation of public policy in the impugned Arbitral Award.

19. The petition under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 being devoid of merits is hereby dismissed with no order as to costs. File be consigned to record room.

Pronounced in open court.
(Alka Malik)
Additional District Judge,
Gurugram, 26.04.2019
